cases.title: Initiate drag event and capture product title and price
cases.description: Drag a product item (data-testid='product-item-1') from the product list and verify that the drag event successfully captures the product's title ('product-title-1') and price ('product-price-1') for transfer.

cases.title: Verify data transfer integrity for products with special characters or long text
cases.description: Drag a product item with special characters or long text in its title from the product list and verify that the drag event correctly captures and transfers both the title and price.

cases.title: Drop product item into drop area to update cart display
cases.description: Drag a product item (data-testid='product-item-1') and drop it into the designated drop area (id='div1', data-testid='drop-area'). Verify that the cart display automatically updates with the product title appearing in .box2, the unit price in .box3, and the quantity in .box1.

cases.title: Drop repeated products into drop area to increment quantity
cases.description: Drag and drop the same product item (data-testid='product-item-1') multiple times into the drop area (id='div1', data-testid='drop-area'). Verify that the system supports repeated products and increments the quantity accordingly in .box1.

cases.title: Calculate and display total price for cart items
cases.description: Verify that the system correctly sums the prices of all products in the cart (supporting both single and multiple items), formats the total to two decimal places with the appropriate currency symbol, and displays it in the div with id='allMoney'.

opinions.feedback: All proposed test cases are clear, distinct, cover the requirements comprehensively, and are fully testable without any blockers.

analysis.analysis: For requirement e2edev_bench_01-R-1: Normal scenario includes dragging a product item (e.g., product-item-1) and successfully capturing the product title (product-title-1) and price (product-price-1) via the drag event transfer. Edge scenario involves verifying data transfer integrity for items with special characters or long text. Unsupported negative scenarios such as testing non-draggable elements are removed per feedback. For requirement e2edev_bench_01-R-3: Normal scenario involves dropping product items into the designated drop area (id='div1', data-testid='drop-area'), updating the cart display with product title in .box2, unit price in .box3, and quantity in .box1. Edge and abnormal scenarios include dropping repeated products to ensure quantity increments properly, and dropping invalid elements not part of the product list. For requirement e2edev_bench_01-R-5: Normal scenario includes calculating the total price of all items in the cart, formatting it to two decimal places with the currency symbol (e.g., '$80.00'), and displaying it in <div id='allMoney'>. Edge scenarios are combined to cover both single and multiple cart items in a single comprehensive test case.
